meta.metaDescription: ila Bank is a digital, mobile only banking entity in Bahrain powered by Bank ABC. The app’s current offerings include completely digital onboarding, instant virtual and physical cards, multi-currency account, an account that offers interest.

content.value: Download the ila app and enjoy banking that reflects you!
Hey, we’re ila, a digital bank!
We’re a new type of bank – one that’s built around you. Your life. Your needs.
For example, we know you’re always on the go. Our virtual card means we’ll be there for you wherever life takes you next – even if you’ve forgotten to take your wallet!
And here’s the clever bit: the more things we do together, the better we’ll get to know each other, and the more we can help.
So, what are you waiting for? Come and join the journey to smarter, digital banking…

content.value: Got a few minutes? Join ila
Join ila on your phone in minutes. As soon as your account is open, you’ll get your virtual card.
Fund your account in seconds in four different ways. Make instant payments and transfers.
Access your statements and balance whenever and wherever you are in the world.
Earn tiered interest on your BHD account as soon as you fund it. Save more, earn more.
Manage your PIN, enable biometric ID, freeze your card – and order a new one, all via the app.

Open and link foreign currency accounts to your card via the app, to make international life
easier.
We’re constantly improving our products based on your needs and new technologies.
Powered by Bank ABC. We have been safeguarding peoples’ financial lives for 40 years.
The lowest income requirement to open an account in the market. Saving shouldn’t be a luxury.
